Services.title: Services
Services.heroSubheadline: I offer comprehensive advice in various areas of law with a close and professional approach.
Services.faq1Q: How much does the first consultation cost?
Services.faq1A: The first consultation serves to evaluate your case. Its cost will be deducted from the final budget if you decide to hire our services.
Services.faq2Q: What is the dismissal process like?
Services.faq2A: We analyze the causes, prepare the conciliation ballot at the CMAC and, if there is no agreement, we defend your interests in court.
Services.faq3Q: Do you handle tax matters for freelancers?
Services.faq3A: Yes, we carry out tax planning, tax filing and resolution of tax agency requirements.
Services.faq4Q: What documentation do I need to start?
Services.faq4A: It depends on the case. In the first consultation, we will detail exactly what documents we need to study your matter in depth.
